annotations.summary: Runner vRack {{ $labels.vrack }} transmit bandwidth exceeds 80% in {{ $labels.cluster }}
annotations.description: The runner Additional IP block has sustained more than 4 Gbps for ten minutes against its 5 Gbps limit. Check per-host vRack traffic against the 1 Gbps NIC limit before adding concurrency. The query counts only the configured private NICs, not primary public interfaces.

model.expr: sum by (cluster, vrack, cidr) (rate(node_network_transmit_bytes_total[5m]) * on (cluster, instance, device) group_left(address) max by (cluster, instance, device, address) (node_network_info) * on (cluster, instance, address) group_left(vrack, cidr) label_replace(label_replace(max by (cluster, node, mac, vrack, cidr) (capt_runner_egress_info), "instance", "$1", "node", "(.*)"), "address", "$1", "mac", "(.*)")) * 8 / 5000000000

title: OVH runner vRack transmit bandwidth near capacity
